verdict.rationale: Rootly documents multiple natural-language interfaces: an in-app AI chat for querying incidents (rootly-docs-21, rootly-docs-53), a conversational Slack AI agent that executes actions from plain-English instructions like 'Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident' (rootly-docs-56), a mobile conversational AI agent (rootly-docs-62), and an MCP server letting users query incidents, on-call schedules, and take action via natural language from Cursor, Claude Code, etc. (rootly-docs-22, rootly-docs-31, rootly-docs-33, rootly-docs-44). This spans web, Slack, mobile, and IDE/agent surfaces. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming these NL commands work reliably in production, and no evidence of broader freeform NL command coverage beyond the documented examples.
